record.bible_text: The king's<WH04428> heart<WH03820> <FI>is<Fi> in the hand<WH03027> of the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>as<Fi> the rivers<WH06388> of water<WH04325>: he turneth<WH05186><WTH8686> it whithersoever he will<WH02654><WTH8799>.<CM>
